label: Technical Editorial
summary: Grid-led explanatory style for architecture, research, and code-aware narrative scenes.
description: A portrait-first technical family that uses strict columns, visible rules, diagram panels, annotations, and code/data evidence callouts instead of decorative illustration.
layoutGrammar: Keep the central mechanism in one dominant panel.
Use the left rail for annotations and guardrails, not extra narrative paragraphs.
Use code or structured data only in the right rail.
Reveal density through segmentation, not tiny text.
Keep rules, dividers, and markers explicit so the scene reads like reviewed technical material.

sourcePolicy.notes: The package documents conceptual references only. No branded screenshots, logos, fonts, or copied UI assets are included.

notes: Wave 1 family package rendered through a dedicated local Remotion root.
Preview artifacts are 9:16 stills generated from the owned family renderer.
